prerequisite: C4 exact-head Pre-Unreal + UE4.27.2 core/production-import green and merged to develop.
purpose: Prepare the fixed-state Shire lighting, sky, fog and water presentation pass that follows C4 while preserving the low-spec target and avoiding premature dynamic-weather or day/night scope.

chapter_state_contract.intent: Warm pastoral readability, soft sky fill, readable lanes and gardens, stable landmark silhouettes.
Only if required by the established P1C01 story state; use bounded authored parameter changes rather than a free-running world cycle.

lighting_contract.key_light: One primary directional-light strategy per authored state; avoid overlapping expensive shadowed keys.
lighting_contract.sky_fill: Use UE4.27-compatible skylight/ambient support with explicit capture/update ownership; no per-frame recapture.
lighting_contract.reflection: Prefer bounded reflection captures and material response over expensive real-time scene-capture systems.
lighting_contract.shadow_rule: Shadow distance, cascade count and movable-light count must remain compatible with DX11 720p Low-Medium / 2GB-class VRAM.
lighting_contract.no_claim: Static or headless success does not establish visual quality or target-device performance.

fog_sky_contract.fog: Use a bounded UE4.27 ExponentialHeightFog-style authored state where needed; do not add volumetric cost by default without measurement.
fog_sky_contract.sky: Keep sky presentation compatible with UE4.27 and fixed chapter states; no true dynamic day/night system in this pass.
fog_sky_contract.weather: Weather presentation is chapter-authored and bounded. Do not infer a dynamic weather cycle.

water_contract.scope: Only Shire water bodies required by the established world map and traversal composition.
water_contract.default_strategy: Low-cost authored surface/material presentation with simple collision/traversal boundaries where required.
restrictions: No always-on planar reflection or scene-capture dependency by default.
No gameplay route, quest, save or world-ownership change.
No water density/detail escalation before target-device measurement.

guards: No free-running dynamic day/night cycle in D.
No expensive water reflection path without measured justification.
No change to C2/C3/C4 material identity, density, quest/save/story or LivingWorld ownership.
No PIE/device/visual/performance acceptance claim without direct evidence.
acceptance: UE4.27.2 compile/import/runtime smoke appropriate to the actual D delta.
Rendered PIE review records the intended chapter-state lighting/sky/fog/water presentation.
Target-device DX11 720p Low-Medium profiling is recorded before performance acceptance.
Manual visual and performance evidence remain distinct from machine validation.
evidence_boundary: Preparation only. D runtime implementation must not begin until C4 is exact-head engine-green and merged.
